answer_1.quote: The NLG module transforms the response into natural language displayed to user.

answer_2.quote: We use the success rate (SR@t) to measure the ratio of successful conversations, i.e. recommended the ground-truth item in t turns.

answer_4.quote: We also performed human evaluations on system responses. For each method, we collected 100 dialogs and asked three workers to evaluate them with three metrics: coherence, fluency and appropriateness.
answer_4.guideline: three metrics: coherence, fluency and appropriateness
